If you view a website (assuming default settings), all sorts of stuff could happen, but only to leak your information; ip, screen size, os, stuff like that, it might freeze your browser a bit too, possibly. Pirated video games are where it gets possible to do really bad things, a video game is just another program, so it can do anything you can do (although it doesn't know your passwords).

Free music, porn, images: the main risk is getting caught pirating stuff, use a VPN, a little adblock, a little noscript.

Free video games and other programs: be careful, check the comments if it's pirated, check the checksum.
